Watching movies together and sharing thoughts afterward

Enjoying outdoor or physical activities like walks, cycling, or simple games

Childhood memories are often built from simple, everyday moments rather than grand occasions. A comforting hug, a bedtime story, a shared laugh, or a few minutes of undivided attention can stay with a child for years.

🧠 Children may not remember every lesson they are taught, but they often remember how they were made to feel. Moments of kindness, encouragement, patience, and connection help shape their confidence, emotional security, and sense of belonging.

The smallest gestures can leave the biggest impressions on a growing child’s heart and mind.

✨ Footprints Preschool — nurturing meaningful moments that help children grow with confidence and care.

🌟 Where Learning Feels Like Play

At Footprints: Play School & Day Care Creche, we believe children learn best when they’re enjoying the journey. Every activity is thoughtfully designed to make learning feel natural, engaging, and full of discovery.

🧠 Through play-based experiences, creative exploration, and caring guidance, children build confidence, communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and curiosity—all while having fun. Our nurturing environment encourages every child to learn at their own pace without pressure.

Because when learning feels like play, children stay curious, confident, and excited to explore every day.

✨ Footprints Preschool — where joyful play inspires meaningful learning.

💛 How Family Time Supports a Child’s Emotional Growth

Family time gives children something they need deeply—connection. Simple moments spent together help children feel loved, secure, and understood, creating a strong foundation for emotional well-being.

🧠 Whether it’s sharing meals, playing games, having conversations, or enjoying everyday activities together, these experiences help children build trust, express emotions more openly, and develop a stronger sense of belonging. For children, quality time is more than just being together—it’s feeling valued and connected.

✨ Footprints Preschool — nurturing emotional growth through meaningful relationships and everyday connections.

🌱 Why Gentle Parenting Needs Clear Boundaries Too

Gentle parenting is often associated with empathy, patience, and understanding—but it doesn't mean saying "yes" to everything. Children thrive when kindness is balanced with clear and consistent boundaries.

🧠 Boundaries help children understand expectations, develop self-discipline, and feel secure in their environment. When limits are communicated calmly and respectfully, children learn responsibility while still feeling heard and supported. The goal is not control, but guidance that helps them navigate the world with confidence.

Children need both connection and structure to grow emotionally and socially.

✨ Footprints Preschool — nurturing children with empathy, guidance, and the right balance of support and boundaries.

🏊 Why Swimming Activities Are Great for Summer Learning

Summer is the perfect time for children to enjoy activities that are both fun and beneficial for their development. Swimming and water-based activities offer opportunities for learning that go far beyond recreation.

🧠 Swimming helps children build physical coordination, balance, and motor skills while encouraging confidence and independence in a new environment. Group water activities also promote social interaction, following instructions, and overcoming small challenges through practice and persistence.

When learning is combined with movement and enjoyment, children stay engaged while developing important life skills.

✨ Footprints Preschool — encouraging active experiences that support healthy growth, confidence, and learning.

featured_reviews.name: Akshata Ankolekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Eager Beaver team truly outdid themselves with this year’s Annual Day celebration. It was nothing short of magical! The Toy Story theme was executed so seamlessly that it felt like we had stepped into a world of joy, imagination, and childhood wonder.

From the thoughtfully chosen songs to the beautifully coordinated performances, every detail reflected the immense effort and dedication of the team. The music selection was absolutely perfect, lively, engaging, and heart-warming keeping the audience captivated right until the very end. Watching the little ones from Pre-Nursery and Nursery perform with such confidence and enthusiasm was incredibly touching. Each child did an amazing job, and it was evident how much love and preparation had gone into guiding them.

A special note of appreciation to Monali Mam, Twisha Mam, Swati Mam, Khushi Teacher, and Pranali and Saroj Didi from the Mahavir Nagar branch, your patience, warmth, and commitment towards the children truly shine through. The way you nurture, encourage, and lovingly shape these little minds is deeply admirable. It takes extraordinary dedication to create such a flawless and memorable event with such young children, and you all did it with grace and heart.

It was also an absolute honour and pleasure to perform at the end, a moment we will cherish dearly. We genuinely had the best time, and the joy on every child’s face said it all.

Heartfelt gratitude to each and every teacher, helper, and team member involved in making this Annual Day so special. Kudos to the entire Eager Beaver family, your hard work does not go unnoticed.

Thank you for creating such beautiful memories for our children. 🌸

featured_reviews.name: jinesh thaker
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an absolutely wonderful experience with Eager Beavers over the past 2 years, covering both pre-nursery and nursery. 🌟 It has been such a beautiful journey watching our child grow in such a warm, caring, and nurturing environment.

From day one, the teachers and staff have been incredibly supportive, patient, and attentive. They truly understand each child’s needs and make learning fun, engaging, and meaningful. The transition from pre-nursery to nursery was seamless, and we could clearly see the positive impact on our child’s confidence, communication, and overall development.

The activities are thoughtfully planned, balancing learning with creativity and play. We especially appreciate how the school focuses not just on academics, but also on social skills, independence, and emotional growth.

Communication with parents has always been excellent, and the entire team is approachable and genuinely invested in each child’s well-being.

We’re so grateful to Eager Beavers for giving our child such a strong and happy foundation. Highly recommended to any parent looking for a safe, loving, and enriching preschool experience!
